verdict.rationale: Pipecat has a dedicated interruptions (barge-in) doc. It states that when the user talks over the bot, the bot stops immediately, in-flight work is cancelled, and the pipeline is ready for new user input. Supporting features include Smart Turn Detection for turn-taking and Krisp noise filtering to prevent false interruptions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of how conversation context is updated after an interruption (e.g., truncating unspoken bot text), and independent or hands-on corroboration that barge-in recovery works reliably.
